title: How does MedSAM segment any medical image with one box?
author: Navansh (AI/ML Engineer)
topic: MedSAM adapts SAM (Segment Anything Model) for medical images via 2D box prompts: image encoder + prompt encoder + mask decoder → 2D segmentation mask.
key_claims: One box can segment any medical image
A single model works across diverse medical-image tasks
Based on SAM (adapted for medical images)

title: AutoBinder Agent: An MCP-Based Agent for End-to-End Protein Binder Design
author: Ge et al. (arXiv:2602.00019, Feb 2026)
topic: LLM + Model Context Protocol coordinates MaSIF + Rosetta + ProteinMPNN + AlphaFold3 for end-to-end protein binder design from target structure.
key_claims: Protocol-driven LLM coordination replaces rigid script-based workflows for drug design
Integrates four SOTA components (MaSIF, Rosetta, ProteinMPNN, AlphaFold3) under one MCP-based agent
Improves reproducibility, extensibility, portability, and auditability
Auditability is protocol-level (which tool ran when), not mathematical (no per-step displacement bound)
notes: Full JSON at /extractions/autobinder-agent-2026.json. Strong parallel to OSIRIS agentic-protein-discovery card — both use agent layers above tools, but AutoBinder has no Theorem 7-style certification.

title: mdRNAcat: A Molecular Dynamics RNA Catalog of REST2 Conformational Ensembles
author: Dorn et al. (arXiv:2610.35204, Oct 2026)
topic: 48-RNA all-atom MD catalog with REST2 replica-exchange (32 Hamiltonian states, 200-300 ns each) and reference-Hamiltonian force reevaluation. Released on HuggingFace (HelmholtzAI-FZJ).
key_claims: First broad-purpose RNA MD catalog with consistent reference-Hamiltonian force reevaluation
48 RNA systems selected for sequence diversity (not just functional class)
REST2 captures conformational variability that single-trajectory MD misses
Reusable resource for data-driven RNA models including coarse-grained force fields
notes: Full JSON at /extractions/mdrna-cat-2026.json. Extends the protein-design dataset thesis to RNA — a candidate for OSIRIS to certify RNA design workflows in future.

title: MedSAM-Agent: Empowering Interactive Medical Image Segmentation with Multi-modal Large Language Models
author: arXiv:2602.03320 (Feb 2026)
topic: MedSAM augmented with a multi-modal LLM agent loop for natural-language-driven, generalizable medical image segmentation across CT/MRI/X-ray/Ultrasound/Endoscopy/Pathology.
key_claims: Generalizable framework: single system handles diverse medical segmentation tasks
Multi-modal LLM enables natural-language interaction with non-expert users
Agent loop improves accuracy through iterative refinement
No mathematical bound on segmentation accuracy — heuristic agent loop
notes: Full JSON at /extractions/medsam-agent-2026.json. Companion to the existing medsam-linkedin-infographic extraction — adds the agentic LLM loop on top of MedSAM.

title: RPCA: a Resolved PSF reconstruction method for undersampled images
author: arXiv:2610.19909 (Oct 2026)
topic: Resolved Point-Spread Function reconstruction for undersampled astronomical images, using pixel-integrated forward modeling + PCA-style spatial decomposition. Recovers sub-pixel PSF structure for deconvolution, photometry, and weak-lensing shape measurement.
key_claims: Recovers sub-pixel PSF structure even when the data is undersampled
Pixel-integrated forward model removes bias from pixel-sample approximations
Low-rank spatial decomposition captures field-dependent PSF variation compactly
Sub-pixel structure is statistically inferred — confidence intervals matter
notes: Full JSON at /extractions/rpca-psf-reconstruction-2026.json. Directly relevant to space-domain cards — PSF uncertainty is a key ingredient OSIRIS's Theorem 7 bound would propagate.

title: A New AI/ML Based Image Reconstruction Technique for Coded-Aperture Instruments
author: arXiv:2610.22709 (Oct 2026)
topic: AI/ML-based image reconstruction for coded-aperture instruments with embedded real-time path. Replaces/augments iterative decoders with a learned neural-network reconstructor that runs on embedded hardware at acquisition rate.
key_claims: Enables real-time reconstruction on embedded hardware (not just offline post-processing)
Pathway for deployment in resource-constrained instruments (small satellites, fielded detectors)
Learned reconstructors can hallucinate sources not present in the data — uncertainty quantification is critical
Generalization across mask patterns, detector responses, source distributions requires careful training
notes: Full JSON at /extractions/coded-aperture-aiml-2026.json. Real-time deployment is the key OSIRIS-relevant angle — a Theorem 7 bound would make real-time output auditable.
